data.reason: False finding: the --baseline view already rescans, it never prints the committed baseline. API._interfaces() runs census = I.scan(repo) then returns I.format_baseline(census); the committed file (I.BASELINE_PATH) is read only in the non-baseline ratchet path. Verified identical at the repro commit 4fadc519c390 and HEAD, and empirically: output equals format_baseline(scan(root)), matching a fresh scan.
